Name: Caffinary Tee
Desc:
The Caffinary Tee isn't about shouting your passion—it's about living it. Made from the Heavy Crew from March, this tee is built for those who appreciate craft without compromise.

 Features - 
 
 
   Heavy-duty cotton construction 
 
   Double-stitched for longevity  
   Minimal design philosophy—zero visible branding        
 
   The Caffinary Tee. For coffee people who value craft over clutter.  
 Comes with the "Do Good Work" Pencil.

Name: Couverture Canephora - Roasted on 29/03
Tasting_Notes: Chocolatey, berry-like, boozy, all in the same coffee?
Desc:
Fine Cup Award Winning Process  
 Exclusive Lot. Limited Edition: 16 kgs. 
 Chocolatey, berry-like, boozy, all in the same coffee? Yes, the complexity of this coffee is truly mind boggling! 
  This is the 3rd year of us bringing the Couverture Canephora to you. This beautiful Robusta is grown by Mr Mahesh Nayananan of TheNaturalFarmer, based in Pulneys, Tamil Nadu, and fermented using their proprietary methods.  
 Canephora, an old name of the Robusta, has us coming back for more. This coffee is fruity, acidic, and chocolatey - with zero bitterness, all at the same time! Tasting this coffee is like drinking a light and boozy Madagascar hot chocolate. Isn’t that mind-blowing? This coffee is a  limited lot of 16kg , and has won the Flavour of India - Fine Cup Award 2023 for Robusta Naturals. 
 We cupped the first edition of this coffee blind, with 5 people, and none of them could say it was a Robusta. It continues to blow many more minds ever since. 
 The coffee beans that go into Couverture Canephora were nurtured for 17 months - 12 months on the plant, 15 days for fermentation, and 4.5 months, for extended slow drying. The result of so much time, love, effort, and attention is something so complex, it opened our eyes.  Coming from sir Mahesh Narayanan and the team at TheNaturalFarmer, this coffee clearly reflects the excellent cultivation practices that the coffee has received during the harvest and beyond, from the nurturing of sapling to plant.

Name: Garnet Vin Doux - Roasted on 07/04
Tasting_Notes: When brewed at 89°C for 2 1/2 mins using an AeroPress , the cup reveals a balanced
Process: ing from Ammikulavi Estate , Tamil Nadu
Desc:
Grown along the outer slopes of the    Palani Hills at 4200 ft , this lot represents a precise approach to Robusta processing from    Ammikulavi Estate , Tamil Nadu. The estate spans 40 acres, where Arabicas occupy the central terrain and Robustas border the edges. 
 Under the direction of    Darshan , a sixth-generation grower and first-generation specialty processor, this coffee undergoes    anaerobic natural fermentation —a sealed environment that intensifies fruit complexity while refining mouthfeel and sweetness. 
 When brewed at    89°C  for  2 1/2 mins using an AeroPress , the cup reveals a balanced, structured profile: 
 
 
 Aromatics:    Ferment-driven winey notes with subtle spice 
 
 Flavor:   Winey, D ark chocolate, prunes, and caramel sweetness. 
 
 Body:    Full, syrupy texture with clean finish. 
 
 Acidity:    Low and integrated, enhancing perceived sweetness. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Taste Profile  -  Winey, Dark Chocolate,  Prunes, Caramel 
 
 
 
 Origin  -   Ammikulavi Estate, Pulneys, TN 
 
 
 
 Processing  - Anaerobic Naturals 
 
 
 
 Elevation  - 4200 ft 
 
 
 
   Roast:  Medium  Acidity:  Low  Sweetness:  Medium

Name: Good Afternoon - The Mid-Day Motivator
Origin: ing Group for a mild bitter kick
Desc:
After battling the morning hustle at the office, your nerves are rightly calling out for a cuppa. Replenish your diminishing energy (and patience, if we may add!) levels with a cup of our Afternoon blend, enough energy to wake you up, but not enough to disrupt your sleep at night. Did you say amazing? Yes, we know!   
 Made using hand-picked Washed Arabica from the SM Plantations, Koraput, Odisha for that chocolatey almond note with a caramel finish, and blended with the washed Robustas of the Rosegarden Farming Group for a mild bitter kick, this  70% Arabica and 30% Robusta  blend is designed to help you sail gracefully through the rest of your day. 
  So get this blend, and get ready for productive afternoons that will leave your coworkers awestruck!

  So what are you waiting for? Get ready for the most energetic mornings ever!   Robusta: Arabica % - 50-50

Name: Prosecco Aventi - Roasted on 27/03
Tasting_Notes: As it cools, a sweet pickled lemon brightness lifts through, tart but rounded
Desc:
Taste Profile  -
   
 Winy, Sweet Pickled Lemon, Malt 
 
 
 
 
 Origin  -   Koraput A1 Coffee Estate, Koraput, Odisha 
 
 
 
 Varietal -  Catimor 
 
 
 
 Processing  -
   
   
     Extended Anaerobic Honey, 240 hrs sun-dried, Split beans 
 
 
 
 
 Elevation  - 3200 ft 
 
 
 
   
  Roast:  Medium  Acidity:  Bright  Sweetness:  High 
 From award-winning estate - Koraput A1 Estate 
 Limited edition of 10kg only 
 
  During harvest, unseasonal rainfall caused a portion of cherries to split — raising the very real risk of farmer losses. Rather than discard them, the lot was carefully segregated and given a second chance through one of the most labour-intensive processes in specialty coffee.    
 
 Each cherry was manually sorted, floated to remove defects, and sealed into fermentation vessels under oxygen-limited conditions for a full 240 hours — 10 days of controlled anaerobic fermentation, closely monitored to build aromatic complexity without tipping into over-fermentation.       
 Post-fermentation, the cherries were depulped with generous mucilage retained — the honey process — and moved to raised drying beds. Given the compromised skins, drying was managed with frequent turning to ensure even moisture migration. The parchment was then conditioned, rested, and dry-milled to grade.        
 Ten days of patience show up exactly where they should. The cup opens with a    winy depth    — that unmistakable ferment character that lingers on the sides of your tongue. As it cools, a    sweet pickled lemon    brightness lifts through, tart but rounded, like a preserved citrus rather than a sharp acid. The finish is long and grounding —    malt    warmth that settles everything into place. Best brewed slow. Best drunk without distraction.

Name: Robustas of Coorg - Roasted on 02/04
Tasting_Notes: chocolates, prunes, and raisins
Origin: estates with less than a ton of production
Desc:
India is a land of smallholder farmers - and even coffee is grown at estates with less than a ton of production. And do you know what is the smallest quantity that can be graded and sorted in most affordable curing houses? A ton. So while we like the highest grade and best bean density in our coffee, the smallholders who do good work, don't get the limelight that they should, for the hard work they put in. Robusta is a healthy child that has adapted well to climate change, and is soon turning into the highlight of this industry, Worldwide.    
  Bhavika states that she had her biases against robusta - but this is the  first coffee  ever, that opened her mind to the possibilities that robusta holds in its folds. She believes it could be the first robusta for a lot of people, too!  
  The roasting, if Robusta conscious (credits to Rajeev Vaishnav), the sweetness and complexity in the bean can develop and shine. Bringing to you, a washed Robusta that is sensitive to the Indian small-holders, a roast that bears in mind the qualities of the bean, and brings you, nothing but the best. The coffee will remind you of chocolates, prunes, and raisins.  
  Proudly presenting, Robustas of Coorg.  
  Special thanks to Ujjwal Rathi for ensuring that his love for this coffee and consistent reminders made us stay on track to share this coffee with the rest of the fam.  
  Recommended Brewing Temperature: 85 Degrees Celcius  
 
 
 
  Taste Profile  
 
     Chocolates, Prunes & Raisins 
 
 
 
  Origin  
 
     Coorg Smallholders, Karnataka 
 
 
 
  Processing  
 
     Washed 
 
 
 
  Elevation  
 
     3000+ ft

Name: Tawny Ristretta - Roasted on 07/04
Desc:
Limited edition of 45kg   Fine Robustas have always been close to our hearts, and this one adds yet another layer to our journey of discovering truly exceptional lots. 
 Hegbal Estate gets its name for   Hebbagillu -   Kannada for "great gateway". R un by Mr Devdas Menezes since 1996, he is a 3rd generational grower who has pioneered specialty harvests and post harvests for both Arabica and Robusta, and believes in a bright future for Robusta.  
 We got our hands on a beautiful bodied batch - an anaerobic Honey fermented twice for 60 hours. The cherries were stored in Ecotact bags, then pulped, and stored in Ecotact bags again.   After six months of experimentation and five distinct roast profiles, we’ve arrived at this expression — one that best highlights the character of this coffee. We’re releasing it in a limited batch at a special price to invite your palate into the conversation. Your feedback will shape how we take this coffee forward in future roasts.
